star_sap_eyes.name: Star-Sap Lenses
star_sap_eyes.description: Crystallized drops of Star-Wood sap set into the irises to read bone and aura.
star_sap_eyes.bonusSummary: Plus 2 Wit and automatic surface combat appraisal.
star_sap_eyes.drawbackSummary: Vulnerable to lightning and raises Defilement by 10.

anatomyOverlay.appendText: Silver crystalline rings catch dim light across the irises.

chitin_skin.name: Chitinous Plates
chitin_skin.description: Layered pale beetle-chitin hardens across shoulders, ribs, and forearms.
chitin_skin.bonusSummary: Plus 3 Armor and resistant to slashing and poison.
chitin_skin.drawbackSummary: Minus 1 Agility, vulnerable to fire and bludgeoning, raises Defilement by 18.

anatomyOverlay.appendText: Segmented ivory chitin plates overlap visibly along ribs and collarbones.

kiln_blood.name: Kiln-Ember Blood
kiln_blood.description: Soul-amber ash runs hot through the veins, turning breath smoky in winter air.
kiln_blood.bonusSummary: Plus 2 Might, resistant to fire and blight, grants Kiln-Spark.
kiln_blood.drawbackSummary: Minus 2 Max Resolve, vulnerable to cold, raises Defilement by 16.

anatomyOverlay.appendText: Faint orange heat shimmers beneath fever-warm veins.

iron_tendon_arms.name: Iron-Wire Tendons
iron_tendon_arms.description: Braided Durnfolk wire stitched directly along forearm sinews for crushing leverage.
iron_tendon_arms.bonusSummary: Plus 2 Might and plus 3 Max Stamina.
iron_tendon_arms.drawbackSummary: Minus 2 Max Focus, vulnerable to lightning, raises Defilement by 12.

anatomyOverlay.appendText: Dark surgical stitches and taut iron wire ridge beneath both forearms.

pale_root_hands.name: Pale-Root Claws
pale_root_hands.description: Calcified root-tendrils lace through the knuckles into pale tearing talons.
pale_root_hands.bonusSummary: Plus 1 Might, plus 1 Agility, resistant to blight, grants Root-Snare.
pale_root_hands.drawbackSummary: Vulnerable to fire, Iron-Vow suspicion, raises Defilement by 20.

anatomyOverlay.appendText: Chalk-white root fibers twine between the knuckles into hardened pale claws.

vesper_ribs.name: Vesper Rib-Cage
vesper_ribs.description: Hollow amber conduits inlaid along the sternum to store resonant focus.
vesper_ribs.bonusSummary: Plus 4 Max Focus, plus 1 Armor, resistant to resonant.
vesper_ribs.drawbackSummary: Minus 3 Max HP, vulnerable to bludgeoning, raises Defilement by 15.

anatomyOverlay.appendText: Dull amber conduits glow faintly beneath tight surgical seams across the sternum.

alkali_glands.name: Alkali Glands
alkali_glands.description: Under-Warren alchemical sacs stitched beneath the jaw to neutralize venom and spit acid.
alkali_glands.bonusSummary: Resistant to acid and poison, grants Vesper-Flask.
alkali_glands.drawbackSummary: Vulnerable to cold, stitched jawline stigma, raises Defilement by 14.

anatomyOverlay.appendText: Copper-sutured swellings line the lower jaw smelling faintly of vinegar.

brass_striders.name: Brass Tendon-Braces
brass_striders.description: Spring-loaded Grixi brass braces pinned into shin and heel tendons.
brass_striders.bonusSummary: Plus 2 Agility and plus 2 Max Stamina.
brass_striders.drawbackSummary: Minus 2 Max Resolve, vulnerable to lightning and acid, raises Defilement by 12.

anatomyOverlay.appendText: Clockwork brass pins click faintly along calves and heels with every spring-loaded stride.

fractured_ribs.name: Fractured Ribs
fractured_ribs.description: Sharp bone pain catches every breath and heavy swing.

torn_tendon.name: Torn Tendon
torn_tendon.description: A ragged tear behind knee or shoulder slows footwork.

deep_laceration.name: Deep Laceration
deep_laceration.description: An open slash that weeps whenever armor shifts.

concussion.name: Cracked Crown
concussion.description: Ringing skull pain blurs concentration and spellcraft.

spore_burn.name: Spore Burn
spore_burn.description: Chalky mycelial blisters sear flesh beneath bandages.

shattered_nerve.name: Shattered Nerve
shattered_nerve.description: Phantom bell-tones leave hands trembling under threat.
